mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day windows following UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates improving consumer demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 60-day windows following HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests economic expansion, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 60-day windows following INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates combined with high unemployment rates indicate a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 20-day windows during low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 5-day windows following PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP combined with a decrease in CPI suggests controlled inflation with growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 60-day windows during GDPC1 increases and CPIAUCSL decreases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates during a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows during high FEDFUNDS.
